tool_input.command:
mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/internal-http.md <<'EOF'
# Plain HTTP for internal hosts

The project's current recorded decision is that HTTPS is mandatory for all hosts, internal hosts included, so plain HTTP is not permitted for internal hosts and no exception applies to them. All transport connections use TLS.
EOF
cat docs/policies/internal-http.md
